newsitem.title: USA: LaserVision Centers adds 10 sites in U.S..
newsitem.headline: LaserVision Centers adds 10 sites in U.S..

text.p: -LaserVision Centers Inc said Friday it agreed to operate its excimer laser to correct nearsightedness at 10 additional sites in the United States.
With the new pacts, LaserVision now has agreed to serve 70 sites in 28 states and said it expects to serve 100 sites by the end of calendar 1997.
LaserVision operates the excimer laser in the United States, Canada, the United Kingdom, Ireland, Sweden, Finland and Greece.
The device allows eye surgeons to correct nearsightedness with an outpatient procedure.
LaserVision said it showed a 34 percent increase from March to April in U.S. surgical case volume. U.S. case volume for the quarter ended April 30 rose 37 percent over the previous quarter.
"Our potential to increase surgical case volume has been greatly enhanced by the ability to share excimer technology among multiple sites," said LaserVision Chairman John Klobnak in a statement.
LaserVision's MobilExcimer was approved on April 7, 1997.
